name: Prince William County Public Schools
districtFact: PWCS publishes a 180-day student calendar, separate teacher workdays, districtwide religious-holiday closures, two official PDF formats, and an academic-calendar subscription for later district updates.

about.title: How to Use the PWCS Calendar
about.content: PWCS publishes districtwide student dates, teacher workdays, school-office closures, and major breaks. Individual schools may add conferences, activities, testing, or bell-schedule changes, so families should also check their school calendar.

about.title: PWCS and the Manassas School Divisions
about.content: Prince William County Public Schools, Manassas City Public Schools, and Manassas Park City Schools are separate school divisions with different calendars. A Manassas mailing address does not by itself identify the school division.

districtFaqs.q: Is Prince William County Public Schools the same as Manassas City Public Schools?
districtFaqs.a: No. Prince William County Public Schools, Manassas City Public Schools, and Manassas Park City Schools are separate school divisions with different calendars. Families should confirm their assigned division using their exact address.

districtFaqs.q: Can families subscribe to the official PWCS calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. PWCS provides an official academic-calendar subscription for calendar apps. A subscription is the best option for receiving later district updates automatically.
